welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: You're a Big Part of This
welcome.text: It started with a tap on the shoulder at a bar — and somehow turned into all of this. We're getting married on August 5, 2028 at Holly Hedge Estate in New Hope — and we can't wait to celebrate with good food, a wide-open dance floor, and the people who got us here. We can't picture it without you.
